class.name: GaussianSplatBakeVolume3D
class.description: Boxes use [member volume_size] in local coordinates. A nonempty [member hull_points] supplies a closed convex hull instead. The bake tests splat centres. Call [method get_bake_descriptor] and pass its dictionary in the [code]volumes[/code] array to [method GaussianSplatWorld.bake_hlod] or [method GaussianSplatHlodAutoTree.build]. The resource has no scene ownership, so descriptors are supplied explicitly. The first matching volume per field in sorted node-path order wins. A matching volume overrides the corresponding PLY property; the report counts disagreements per field.

method.name: get_bake_descriptor
method.description: Returns the volume kind, node path, semantic name, shape, wind weight and transform into the splat payload's bake coordinates. For a transformed world node, pass its inverse global transform. JSON jobs use size and hull points as number arrays and the transform as nine row-major basis numbers followed by three origin numbers.

members.member: Positive local box dimensions; used when hull_points is empty.
Local points defining a convex hull. At least four noncoplanar points are required; invalid hulls fail the bake.
